paper_card.title: Manganese Doping Raises Visible-Light Conversion over TiO2
paper_card.research_question: Does manganese doping raise visible-light conversion over TiO2?
paper_card.data: Two synthetic TiO2 samples tested at 25 °C and 1 bar.
paper_card.methods: Annealing at 450 °C for 3 h; 2 wt% Mn doping; 50 mg catalyst; each condition measured twice.
findings: The doped sample reached 85% conversion after 2 h, compared with 70% for pristine TiO2
limitations: The manganese content was not measured after reaction, so the mechanism is not proven
The evidence for increased visible-light absorption is indirect
